retweeted_tweet.text:
since jev release, small models are hot

time-series foundation model (tsfm) are really interesting. for the past 6 months i've been diving into them for @miroshark_ 

instead of reading text and predicting the next word, it is pre-trained on billions of numerical data points to predict the next steps in a chart.

you feed it 512 hours of past history, and it forecasts the future trajectory with confidence bands.

the immediate value in crypto is obvious: plug in price charts & build a trading bot.

i've been running a (smol) benchmark, testing 18 models across crypto and stocks, from hosted endpoints to local weights (amazon chronos, google timesfm, datadog toto, tirex).

is it ready to beat the market? nope. zero models beat a dumb baseline. not a single model outperformed a simple horizontal flatline ("price stays unchanged") over 24-hour horizons.
